source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of network performance (PDF 19).

blocks.text: Network performance ka matlab hai network kitna achha kaam karta hai: data muntaqili ki raftar aur miyar. Achhi karkardagi tez, hamwaar baat-cheet deti hai; buri karkardagi sust Internet aur deri paida karti hai. Karkardagi kai awamil, jaise bandwidth aur latency, par munhasir hai.

blocks.caption: Bandwidth aur latency
rows: Muqarrara waqt mein bheja ja sakne wala data: network kitna data utha sakta hai
Data ke safar ka waqt: bhejne aur wusool karne ke darmiyan deri
Kam bandwidth, ya bohat se devices ka share karna, Internet sust karta
Zyada latency lag paida karti; online games aur video calls ko kam latency chahiye

blocks.title: Bandwidth aur asal raftar
blocks.text: Darasal bandwidth link ki zyada se zyada raftar hai; asal mein hasil hone wali raftar, jise throughput kehte hain, aksar kam hoti hai kyunke link share hota hai aur deri aur ghaltiyan hoti hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Diye gaye manzarname mein deri ki mumkina wajuhat pehchanein.

blocks.prompt: Video call baar baar ruk jati hai halanke bari file tezi se download hoti hai. Masla bandwidth ka zyada lagta hai ya latency ka? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Latency (deri). Tez download dikhata hai ke bandwidth kafi hai; live video call ko har packet jaldi chahiye, is liye zyada ya badalti deri use rok deti hai.

items: Performance: data muntaqili ki raftar aur miyar.
Bandwidth: fi waqt data (Mbps), zyada behtar; latency: deri (ms), kam behtar.
Deri ki wajuhat: zyada users, ghatiya cables, faasla, congestion, hardware kharabi.
